title: The Player (Brendan / May)
description: The protagonist: Norman's child, who moves to Littleroot Town and sets out to complete the Pokédex and become Champion. Chosen as Brendan or May at the start; the other becomes the rival.
history: Player name/gender are runtime values ({PLAYER}, FLAG gender checks). Sprites have normal, bike, surfing, field-move, fishing, watering, decorating and underwater variants.

title: The Rival (May / Brendan)
description: Prof. Birch's child and the player's neighbour and friendly rival. Battles the player five times (Route 103, Rustboro, Route 110, Route 119, Lilycove), always with the starter strong against the player's.
history: Which character appears depends on the player's gender; trainer variants are keyed by the player's starter.

title: Mom
description: The player's mother. Welcomes the player to Littleroot, gives the Running Shoes and heals the party at home.

title: Norman (Dad)
description: The player's father and Petalburg City Gym Leader (Normal type). Asks the player to help Wally, and is the fifth Gym battle once the player has four badges. Gives the S.S. Ticket after the Hall of Fame.
history: The family moved to Hoenn because Norman became Petalburg's Gym Leader.

title: Rival's Mom
description: Prof. Birch's wife, who welcomes the player next door.

title: Prof. Birch
description: Hoenn's Pokémon Professor, who studies Pokémon habitats in the field. Rescued by the player on Route 101, gives the starter and the Pokédex, rates Pokédex progress via PC and upgrades it to National.
history: Appears in the opening speech (src/main_menu.c / birch speech) and at the Champion's room.

title: Wally
description: A frail boy from Petalburg moving to Verdanturf for his health. The player helps him catch Ralts; he battles the player in Mauville and, recovered and confident, at Victory Road with Gardevoir.
history: Victory Road rematches wally-vr-2..5 are post-game rematches.

title: Wally's Uncle
description: Wally's uncle, who looks after him in Verdanturf and worries about his health.

title: Wally's Father
description: Gives the player HM03 Surf after the Balance Badge, in thanks for helping his son.

title: Wanda
description: Wally's cousin in Verdanturf, whose boyfriend is digging Rusturf Tunnel by hand to reach her.

title: Steven Stone
description: Son of Devon's president and a collector of rare stones. Met in Granite Cave, he gives the Devon Scope, fights beside the player at the Mossdeep Space Center, gives HM08 Dive, and guides the player during the Sootopolis crisis. Battled post-game in Meteor Falls.
history: Lives in Mossdeep; his house later gives the player a Beldum.

title: Mr. Stone
description: President of Devon Corporation and Steven's father. Gives the PokéNav and asks the player to deliver a letter to Steven and the Devon Goods to Capt. Stern; later gives the Exp. Share.

title: Devon Researcher
description: Devon Corp. employee robbed in Petalburg Woods and whose Devon Goods are stolen in Rustboro.

title: Mr. Briney
description: A retired sea captain on Route 104 who sails the player to Dewford and Slateport after the player rescues his Wingull, Peeko. Later seen on the S.S. Tidal.

title: Peeko
description: Mr. Briney's beloved Wingull, kidnapped by Team Aqua in Rusturf Tunnel and rescued by the player.

title: Capt. Stern
description: Slateport ocean researcher building a submarine with Devon parts. Team Aqua steals the submarine from Lilycove; he later hands over the Scanner exchange and shows up on the S.S. Tidal.

title: Prof. Cozmo
description: Fallarbor meteorite researcher whose meteorite is taken by Team Magma at Meteor Falls. Gives TM27 Return when it is returned.

title: Rydel
description: Owner of Rydel's Cycles in Mauville; lends the Mach or Acro Bike and lets the player swap between them.

title: Wattson
description: Mauville Gym Leader (Electric) and the city's redeveloper. Asks the player to shut off the generator in New Mauville (Basement Key, TM24 Thunderbolt).

title: Roxanne
description: Rustboro Gym Leader (Rock), an honour student of the Pokémon Trainer's School.

title: Brawly
description: Dewford Gym Leader (Fighting), a surfer who trains in the waves and caves around Dewford.

title: Flannery
description: Lavaridge Gym Leader (Fire), newly appointed and trying hard to live up to her grandfather.

title: Winona
description: Fortree Gym Leader (Flying), who soars with her bird Pokémon.

title: Tate
description: One of the twin Mossdeep Gym Leaders (Psychic); fights alongside his sister Liza in a double battle.

title: Liza
description: One of the twin Mossdeep Gym Leaders (Psychic); fights alongside her brother Tate.

title: Juan
description: Sootopolis Gym Leader (Water) and Wallace's former mentor, who returns as Leader after Wallace becomes Champion.

title: Sidney
description: Elite Four member (Dark).

title: Phoebe
description: Elite Four member (Ghost) who trained on Mt. Pyre.

title: Glacia
description: Elite Four member (Ice) who came to Hoenn to train.

title: Drake
description: Elite Four member (Dragon), a former sailor and the last of the four.

title: Wallace
description: Hoenn Champion (Water) and former Sootopolis Gym Leader. Guards the Cave of Origin during the crisis, gives HM07 Waterfall, and is the final battle of the main story.

title: Scott
description: A talent scout who keeps turning up to watch the player (Rustboro school, Battle Tents, Ever Grande) and finally invites them to his Battle Frontier.

title: Maxie
description: Leader of Team Magma, who wants to expand the land for people by awakening Groudon. Battled at Mt. Chimney, Magma Hideout and the Mossdeep Space Center.

title: Tabitha
description: Team Magma Admin and Maxie's right hand.

title: Archie
description: Leader of Team Aqua, who wants to expand the sea for Pokémon by awakening Kyogre. First seen at the Oceanic Museum, battled in the Seafloor Cavern.

title: Matt
description: Team Aqua Admin battled in the Aqua Hideout.

title: Shelly
description: Team Aqua Admin battled at the Weather Institute and in the Seafloor Cavern.

title: Mt. Pyre's elderly couple
description: The old couple guarding the Red and Blue Orbs at Mt. Pyre's summit. The woman gives the player the Magma Emblem.

title: Gabby & Ty
description: A TV interviewer and cameraman duo who roam Hoenn's routes and challenge the player to double battles for their show.
history: Their interviews feed the TV system (data/text/tv.inc).

title: Lanette
description: Creator of the Pokémon Storage System PC ('LANETTE's PC').

title: Anabel (Salon Maiden)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Tower.

title: Tucker (Dome Ace)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Dome.

title: Spenser (Palace Maven)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Palace.

title: Greta (Arena Tycoon)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Arena.

title: Noland (Factory Head)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Factory.

title: Lucy (Pike Queen)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Pike.

title: Brandon (Pyramid King)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Pyramid.

title: Team Aqua
description: Villainous team led by Archie that wants to expand the oceans by awakening Kyogre with the Red Orb. Base: Aqua Hideout in Lilycove.

title: Team Magma
description: Villainous team led by Maxie that wants to expand the landmass by awakening Groudon with the Blue Orb. Base: Magma Hideout inside Mt. Chimney.

title: Devon Corporation
description: Rustboro-based manufacturer of Poké Balls, the PokéNav, Devon Scope and submarine parts; run by Mr. Stone.

title: Pokémon League
description: Hoenn's league at Ever Grande City: Elite Four and Champion, reached by Victory Road after eight badges.

title: Rustboro Gym
description: Rock-type Gym, Leader Roxanne. Stone Badge.

title: Dewford Gym
description: Fighting-type Gym (dark maze), Leader Brawly. Knuckle Badge.

title: Mauville Gym
description: Electric-type Gym (switch barriers), Leader Wattson. Dynamo Badge.

title: Lavaridge Gym
description: Fire-type Gym (hot-spring geysers), Leader Flannery. Heat Badge.

title: Petalburg Gym
description: Normal-type Gym (themed rooms), Leader Norman. Balance Badge.

title: Fortree Gym
description: Flying-type Gym (rotating gates), Leader Winona. Feather Badge.

title: Mossdeep Gym
description: Psychic-type Gym (warp tiles, double battle), Leaders Tate & Liza. Mind Badge.

title: Sootopolis Gym
description: Water-type Gym (cracking ice floor), Leader Juan. Rain Badge.

title: Weather Institute
description: Route 119 research centre studying weather and the Pokémon that change it; occupied by Team Aqua; later tracks Kyogre/Groudon.

title: Mossdeep Space Center
description: Rocket launch facility in Mossdeep, targeted by Team Magma for its rocket fuel.

title: Oceanic Museum / Stern's Shipyard
description: Capt. Stern's ocean research institutions in Slateport.

title: Battle Frontier
description: Scott's post-game island of seven battle facilities, each with a Frontier Brain.

title: Pokémon Contests
description: Cool/Beauty/Cute/Smart/Tough contests at Normal, Super, Hyper and Master rank, held in Lilycove's Contest Hall.

title: Trick House
description: Route 110 house of the Trick Master, with eight puzzle mazes unlocked by badges.

title: Pokémon Fan Club
description: Slateport club whose chairman rates Pokémon condition and gives scarves.

title: Pokémon Center
description: Nationwide healing centres with nurse Joy-style nurses, PC and link rooms.

title: Poké Mart
description: Item shops; inventory expands with badges (see mart_inventory.csv).

title: Safari Zone
description: Route 121 park where Pokémon are caught with Safari Balls and Pokéblocks.

title: Pokémon Day Care
description: Route 117 couple who raise Pokémon and find Eggs.

title: Mauville Game Corner
description: Slots and roulette for coins and prizes.

title: Pokémon Trainer's School
description: Rustboro school for young Trainers (Quick Claw gift, Scott's first appearance).
